records.text: Ravaged Cadaver is a hostile undead cadaver encountered in combat. It uses Strike, and its death is accompanied by a line describing the broken body rising again.
Mangled Cadaver is a hostile undead cadaver that casts Cadaver Worms. Its death is accompanied by a line describing the broken body rising again.
Spectral Citizen reacts to bow, dance, kiss, wave and rude emotes. It can return a rude gesture to the player.
Ghostly Citizen is a hostile spectral figure that can return a rude gesture to the player.
Skeletal Guardian is a hostile skeletal combatant that casts Demon Armor while out of combat.
Skeletal Berserker is a hostile skeletal combatant that uses Strike in combat.
Skul is a solitary, high-ranking spellcaster. Skul casts Frost Armor while out of combat and uses Frostbolt, Frost Shock, and Blizzard in combat.
Thuzadin Shadowcasters are numerous spellcasting undead in the same area as the Thuzadin Acolytes. They cast Shadow Channeling while out of combat.

Thuzadin Acolytes rally their brethren when Ash’ari Crystals are destroyed or toppled. Their warnings call for loyalty to the Lich King, resummoning a fallen crystal, and restoring the ziggurat before the Slaughterhouse is vulnerable; they urge their allies to slay intruders.
Thuzadin Necromancers are spellcasting members of the Thuzadin ranks. They summon a skeletal servant while out of combat.
Plague Ghouls are combat creatures whose attack is Ghoul Plague. A line announces when one becomes enraged.
Ghoul Raveners are combat creatures that use Head Crack and perform a nonverbal emote while out of combat.
A Fleshflayer Ghoul in Stratholme, it attacks intruders with Rend and can be heard giving a rasping idle emote.
A Rockwing Gargoyle found in Stratholme, it fights intruders with Sunder Armor.
A Rockwing Screecher in Stratholme, it gives a shrill sound when it notices a threat and joins the fight.
An Eye of Naxxramas serves as a watcher in Stratholme, warning, “The living are here!” when it spots intruders. It can vanish from sight while out of combat.
A Crypt Crawler of Stratholme, it attacks with Enveloping Web, using its webbing against intruders.
A Crypt Beast in Stratholme, it attacks with Encasing Webs to hinder its foes.
A Patchwork Horror in Stratholme, it strikes intruders with a forceful Knock Away.

A Bile Spewer is a hulking creature that belches out Bile Slime and can burst apart to release more. Its recorded combat calls describe those attacks, giving it a distinctly grotesque battlefield role.
A Venom Belcher is a poisonous creature whose combat routine applies Slowing Poison. Its role is defined by that venomous attack.
A Crimson Guardsman is a frontline defender who urges others to fall back and hold the line, warning that failure would put everything at risk. The guardsman backs that command with a shield charge.
A Crimson Conjuror is a spellcaster assigned to defend the stairs. It orders others there and attacks with Frostbolt.
A Crimson Initiate is a combatant who attacks with Mind Blast.
A Crimson Defender supports the fighting with Devotion Aura, marking it as a protective combat role among the Crimson forces.
The Crimson Sorcerer is an elite spellcaster among the Stratholme combatants.
The Crimson Priest is an elite combatant whose role is marked by Holy Smite, a direct offensive spell used in combat.

The Crimson Gallant is a defender who rallies others when the Hall of Lights is breached and calls for resistance when the Scourge break through the wings. It fights with Retribution Aura and Crusader Strike, presenting a determined defense of the hall.
The Crimson Battle Mage is an elite combat spellcaster whose combat technique is Arcane Explosion.
The Crimson Inquisitor is an elite combatant whose tactic is Mana Burn. That gives this inquisitor a magical role in battle.

Magistrate Barthilas serves as a warning voice at the Service Gate: he calls out intruders and insists that Lord Rivendare be warned. In combat he uses Furious Anger and Crowd Pummel, giving the magistrate a forceful role in defending the gate.
Baroness Anastari drops a Plagued Flesh Sample. Betina Bigglezink requests these samples for her plague research.
Nerub'enkan is a named combatant who uses Encasing Webs and Pierce Armor.
Maleki the Pallid is a named combatant who uses Frostbolt and Ice Tomb.

Baron Rivendare rules the Scourge's domain and treats intruders as Argent Dawn pawns. He holds an Argent Dawn prisoner and threatens her execution to drive challengers away. When they persist, he orders Ramstein to greet them, then taunts them and threatens the prisoner again. He announces the Slaughterhouse's vulnerability after the Ash'ari Crystals are destroyed.
Shrieking Banshees are combatants that use Banshee Wail.
Wailing Banshees are combatants that use Anti-Magic Shield.
The Unforgiven is an undead combatant in Stratholme that can cast Frost Nova.
Hearthsinger Forresten is an undead combatant in Stratholme. In combat, Forresten uses Shoot, Multi-Shot, Demoralizing Shout and Enchanting Lullaby.
Timmy the Cruel is a dangerous adversary whose cry announces his appearance; he answers a threat with a yell and attacks with Ravenous Claw.
Stonespine is an undead combatant in Stratholme who uses Vicious Rend in combat.
Archivist Galford is a man of the Scarlet Crusade associated with Stratholme, watching over some of the Crusade's most valued documents.
Grand Crusader Dathrohan threatens enemies with the true might of the Nathrezim. He says they have undone years of his work and vows revenge.

Aurius was a paladin of the Silver Hand whose faith wavered, leaving him vulnerable to the Scourge and close to becoming a death knight. He escaped to the sacred chapel in Stratholme, where its power helps him resist that corruption. He seeks the Medallion of Faith so he can leave and fulfill his duty: confronting Baron Rivendare, whom he blames for corrupting him and many fellow paladins. He expects to aid those who face Rivendare, If he is mortally wounded, he believes his soul has been saved.
Cannon Master Willey is a Stratholme combatant who pummels opponents and summons Crimson Riflemen during battle. He also brings riflemen forth when he dies.
Malor the Zealous is a named combatant. In combat, he uses Ground Smash and Head Crack.
Crimson Monks are Scarlet Crusade combatants who voice the Crusade’s resolve to hold its line, smite the wicked, and destroy those carrying the Scourge’s taint.
Stratholme Courier is a combatant whose abilities include Incorporeal Defense and Pummel against a victim casting a spell.
Balzaphon is a named combatant who uses Frostbolt and Cone of Cold in battle.
Elder Farwhisper speaks of the heavens and stars as a source of truth, and visitors can ask him about Elders Snowcrown and Windrun.

Anthion Harmon regrets that he and others split Valthalak’s medallion without understanding its curse, and says Theldren beat him when he tried to reclaim a piece. He seeks help recovering the fragments and directs the effort to Falrin Treeshaper for a way to provoke Theldren. Anthion says restoring the medallion can stop the spell; at parting, he says he can finally rest and that his time in the world is short.

Ysida Harmon was taken prisoner by Baron Rivendare while serving the Argent Dawn’s crusade, despite Anthion’s objections. She speaks of the foul magic tainting her prison and plans cleansing rituals there. After Anthion dies trying to rescue her, she asks that her locket reach him as proof she is well, and says she cannot bear for him to linger in the world.

place_records.text: You are in Stratholme, a place in the Eastern Plaguelands. Baron Rivendare rules the Scourge's domain here and treats intruders as Argent Dawn pawns. Timmy the Cruel, a dangerous adversary, and Cannon Master Willey, who summons Crimson Riflemen during fighting, are among the combatants, and Skeletal Guardians fill the place. Ysida Harmon, who served the Argent Dawn's crusade, is held prisoner by Rivendare.
